invariants.rationale: A valid instantTime is likely required for identifying the operation time in metadata operations.
The method is expected to operate on a collection of partitions, so it should not be null.
Ensures that the partitions parameter is truly a List as required by the method signature.
An empty instantTime may not make sense for versioned metadata operations.
Covering that at method entry, partitions is a List and thus isEmpty can be safely called if non-null.
